'''Ivok''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Biologist/Legends|bioanalyst]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. As a bioanalyst and a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]], Ivok worked aboard [[Carrick Station]], where he kept a small shop. There, he bought and sold valuable [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and medicines.

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Ivok appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Bioanalysis crew skill trainer aboard Carrick Station.
